Journal.Title: The Journal of clinical endocrinology and metabolism

Article.ArticleTitle: Identification of Genetic and Environmental Factors Predicting Metabolically Healthy Obesity in Children: Data From the BCAMS Study.

Abstract.AbstractText: This study provides novel insights into the heterogeneity of obesity, and has the potential to impact the optimization of the intervention options and regimes in the management of pediatric obesity.
